new_declarations.source_signature: theorem padding_pos (C L : ℕ) : 0 < padding C L

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.padding_coprime
new_declarations.source_signature: theorem padding_coprime (C L : ℕ) : (padding C L).Coprime C

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.lt_padding
new_declarations.source_signature: theorem lt_padding {C L : ℕ} (hC : 0 < C) : L < padding C L

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.self_le_consecutive_power_gap
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem self_le_consecutive_power_gap {x n : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    x ≤ x ^ n - (x - 1) ^ n

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.gap_mul
new_declarations.source_signature: theorem gap_mul (p M T : ℕ) : gap p (M * T) = gap p M * T ^ p

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.le_gap
new_declarations.source_signature: theorem le_gap {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (M : ℕ) : M ≤ gap p M

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.factor
new_declarations.source_signature: def factor (p B y : ℕ) : ℕ

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.product
new_declarations.source_signature: def product (p B y : ℕ) : ℕ

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.factor_pos
new_declarations.source_signature: theorem factor_pos (p B y : ℕ) : 0 < factor p B y

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.product_pos
new_declarations.source_signature: theorem product_pos (p B y : ℕ) : 0 < product p B y

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.factor_coprime
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem factor_coprime (p B y : ℕ) :
    (factor p B y).Coprime (p * Shift.primeProduct p B y * y)

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.factor_coprime_lower
new_declarations.source_signature: theorem factor_coprime_lower (p B y : ℕ) : (factor p B y).Coprime y

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.product_coprime_lower
new_declarations.source_signature: theorem product_coprime_lower (p B y : ℕ) : (product p B y).Coprime y

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.gap_coprime
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem gap_coprime {p B y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpy : ¬ p ∣ y) :
    (gap p (product p B y)).Coprime y

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.lower_pow_lt_factor
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem lower_pow_lt_factor {p B y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hy : 0 < y) :
    y ^ p < factor p B y

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.factor_le_gap
new_declarations.source_signature: theorem factor_le_gap {p B y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : factor p B y ≤ gap p (product p B y)

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.size_condition
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem size_condition {p B y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hy : 0 < y) :
    y ^ p < Shift.base p (product p B y) y ^ p -
      (Shift.base p (product p B y) y - 1) ^ p

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.small_prime_not_dvd_factor
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem small_prime_not_dvd_factor {p B y q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hB : q ≤ B) :
    ¬ q ∣ factor p B y

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.small_prime_dvd_gap
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem small_prime_dvd_gap {p B y q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hB : q ≤ B) (hqy : ¬ q ∣ y) : q ∣ gap p (product p B y)

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.small_prime_product_valuation
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem small_prime_product_valuation {p B y q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hB : q ≤ B) (hqy : ¬ q ∣ y) : padicValNat q (p * product p B y) = 1

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.small_prime_valuation_exact
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem small_prime_valuation_exact {p B y q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ho : Odd p)
    (hpy : ¬ p ∣ y) (hq : q.Prime) (hB : q ≤ B) :
    padicValNat q (Shift.base p (product p B y) y ^ p - y ^ p) = if q ∣ y then 0 else p

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.small_prime_local_completion
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem small_prime_local_completion {p B y q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ho : Odd p)
    (hpy : ¬ p ∣ y) (hq : q.Prime) (hB : q ≤ B) :
    p ∣ padicValNat q (Shift.base p (product p B y) y ^ p - y ^ p)

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.not_dvd_residual_of_small_prime
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem not_dvd_residual_of_small_prime {p B y q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ho : Odd p)
    (hpy : ¬ p ∣ y) (hq : q.Prime) (hB : q ≤ B) :
    ¬ q ∣ Shift.residual p (product p B y) y

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.exists_prime_escape_with_address
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem exists_prime_escape_with_address {p B y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ho : Odd p)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hpy : ¬ p ∣ y) :
    ∃ q, q.Prime ∧ B < q ∧ q ∣ Shift.residual p (product p B y) y ∧
      ¬ p ∣ padicValNat q (Shift.residual p (product p B y) y) ∧
      primeOrder q (Shift.base p (product p B y) y) y = p ∧ p ∣ q - 1

new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem finite_set_compensation_and_escape {p y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ho : Odd p)

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.parameter_prime_dvd_gap
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem parameter_prime_dvd_gap {p M q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hd : q ∣ p * M) : q ∣ gap p M

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.difference_valuation_of_residual_prime
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem difference_valuation_of_residual_prime {p M y q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ho : Odd p)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hc : (gap p M).Coprime y) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hqr : q ∣ Shift.residual p M y) :
    padicValNat q (Shift.base p M y ^ p - y ^ p) = padicValNat q (Shift.residual p M y)

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.exists_prime_escape_in_difference
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem exists_prime_escape_in_difference {p B y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ho : Odd p)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hpy : ¬ p ∣ y) :
    ∃ q, q.Prime ∧ B < q ∧ q ∣ Shift.base p (product p B y) y ^ p - y ^ p ∧
      ¬ p ∣ padicValNat q (Shift.base p (product p B y) y ^ p - y ^ p) ∧
      primeOrder q (Shift.base p (product p B y) y) y = p ∧ p ∣ q - 1

new_declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.PrimePowerCompensation.Lift.exists_primitive_nonpower_with_local_completion
new_declarations.source_signature:
theorem exists_primitive_nonpower_with_local_completion {p y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ho : Odd p)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hpy : ¬ p ∣ y) (S : Finset ℕ) :
    ∃ x, y < x ∧ x.Coprime y ∧ (¬ ∃ a : ℕ, a ^ p = x ^ p - y ^ p) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ S, q.Prime → padicValNat q (x ^ p - y ^ p) = if q ∣ y then 0 else p
